newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish March T-bill auction draws higher rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish March T-bill auction draws higher rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Tuesday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.68 percent for the three month series, 3.75 percent for the six month series and 3.95 percent for a new 10-month series.

One month ago, the three month series, then with a maturity of four months, yielded 3.54 percent with the six month series, at that time with a maturity of seven months, yielding 3.58 percent. The central bank said it sold 4.6 billion crowns worth of the three month series and 3.6 billion crowns worth of the six months series.
It said it also sold 6.6 billion crowns worth of the 10-month series, giving a total of 14.8 billion crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
